Not only do you need a great moisturizer to go over your tretinoin, you should also think about layering a lighter moisturizer under your tretinoin. title: What is Ellacor & Who Is it For?
caption:
In this short, Dr. Ariel Ostad explains how Ellacor works—a minimally invasive treatment that uses micro-coring technology to remove tiny columns of skin, stimulating natural collagen production and tightening without surgery.

Ellacor is ideal for patients with mild to moderate skin laxity who want noticeable improvement in sagging and texture with less downtime than a traditional facelift. Learn who’s a good candidate, what results to expect, and how this treatment fits into modern skin rejuve
transcript: Hi everyone, Dr. Ariel Ostad here. Great to be here with you. I wanted to talk to you about the exciting news of performing Ellacor 2.0 in my practice. Ellacor, for those of you who do not know, is basically a micro-coring treatment. Micro-coring means that under local anesthesia, little tiny cores of skin are actually removed. It measures roughly around 0.4 mm, which is incredibly narrow, but it's definitely wider than a needle. So, as opposed to microneedling procedure, so we're actually removing skin. With Ellacor, we're able to efficiently remove about up to 8% of the skin. Primarily used for the lower face to treat jowling. As we age, we get excessive skin that sits here, and for those of patients who are not ideal candidates for facelift or patients who do not want to go through that procedure, micro-coring allows us to remove these little cores of skin under local anesthesia. The recovery is really quick. It's about 5 days, and basically patients get this tightening effect over a course of 2 to 3 months. Studies show that you need about two treatments spaced two months apart, and you can achieve really nice results. We use it not only on the face, we can use it for crepiness on the neck. We can use it off the face on the body for loose skin on the abdomen, especially now that patients are on these GLP-1 agonists. With weight loss, we can treat really knees, elbows, and lots of other areas. Thank you so much.

transcript: Te dijeron que el ácido hielorónico se reabsorbía o que si algo salía mal te lo disolvían, pero eso es una mentira. Cuando publiqué mi vídeo del ácido hielorónico, muchos médicos estéticos vinieron a decirme que yo estaba desinformando, que el problema no es el producto que en manos de profesionales todo es seguro, y que si algo sale mal te inyectan hieloronidasa y eso se disuelve y listo. El ácido hielorónico que te inyectan no es el ácido que produce tu cuerpo, es una versión modificada químicamente, se llama ácido hielorónico reticulado. Diseñado específicamente para que ni tu sistema ni la hieloronidasa lo puedan degradar fácilmente, por eso dura meses. Por eso no se va, no se reabsorbe en migra, se desplaza dentro de tu tejido, se acumula y se expande porque atrae agua, y en algunos casos tu cuerpo lo encapsula porque no sabe qué hacer con él. La hieloronidasa, el famoso antídoto, fue redefinida en estudios recientes, ya no se considera un disolvente, se considera un modificante. Lo que más puede hacer es suavizar el relleno para remoldearlo, pero los años que ese tejido vivió con eso que es antinatural, eso no se revierte. La evidencia científica muestra que tampoco se va del todo y dejan huella en el tejido. No estoy aquí para darte miedo, estoy aquí porque cuando algo es nuevo primero vemos los beneficios y las consecuencias aparecen años después, cuando la industria llaga no su dinero y nosotros quedamos perjudicados. How it works:  The sclerotherapy solution, polidocanol, is injected through tiny needles, targeting the damaged veins. The solution irritates the lining of the vein, causing it to disappear. Over the next few weeks, the treated veins are naturally absorbed in the body, leading to no more leg veins! It’s recommended to have 3 sessions of Sclerotherapy spaced 6 weeks apart for optimal results. These results will last over 2-3 years!
